00074   numInputs(ugen::clip(numInputsToUse, 1, 2)),
00075   numOutputs(ugen::clip(numOutputsToUse, 1, 2)),
00076   blockSize(preferredBufferSize <= 0 ? DEFAULTBLOCKSIZE : preferredBufferSize),
00077   floatBuffer(new float[ugen::max(numInputs, numOutputs) * blockSize]),
00078   currentBlockID(-1)

00106 int AndroidIOHost::processBlock(const int bufferLength, short *shortBuffer) throw()
00107 {
00108   float *floatBufferData[2];
00109   floatBufferData[0] = floatBuffer;
00110   floatBufferData[1] = floatBuffer + blockSize;
00111   
00112   static const float upScale = 32767.f;
00113   static const float downScale = 1.f / upScale;
00114   
00115   for(int channel = 0; channel < numInputs; channel++)
00116   {
00117     short *shortBufferChannel = shortBuffer + channel;
00118     float *floatBufferChannel = floatBufferData[channel];
00119     
00120     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00121     
00122     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00123     {
00124       *floatBufferChannel = (float)(*shortBufferChannel) * downScale;
00125       
00126       floatBufferChannel++;
00127       shortBufferChannel += numInputs;
00128     }
00129   }
00130   
00131   lock(); 
00132   {
00133     // set inputs...
00134     input.setInputs((const float**)floatBufferData, blockSize, numInputs);
00135     
00136     // set outputs
00137     output.setOutputs(floatBufferData, blockSize, numOutputs);
00138     
00139     currentBlockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(blockSize);
00140     output.prepareAndProcessBlock(blockSize, currentBlockID, -1);
00141   }
00142   unlock(); 
00143 
00144   for(int channel = 0; channel < numOutputs; channel++)
00145   {
00146     short *shortBufferChannel = shortBuffer + channel;
00147     float *floatBufferChannel = floatBufferData[channel];
00148     
00149     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00150     
00151     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00152     {
00153       *shortBufferChannel = (short)(*floatBufferChannel * upScale);
00154             
00155       floatBufferChannel++;
00156       shortBufferChannel += numInputs;
00157     }
00158   }
00159   
00160   return 0;
00161 }
